message:
We all have that one friend who seems to panic at the slightest sign of trouble. 🌀 Last week, during a thunderstorm, they texted us asking if we had enough water and snacks stored up for a potential power outage. It made us chuckle at first, but then we realized how important it is to be prepared without the stress. 

It’s a good reminder that having a simple plan and a few essentials ready can help us feel calm and collected, even when the skies are a bit gray. After all, preparedness doesn’t have to be overwhelming—it can just be a thoughtful way to care for ourselves and each other. 

What little things do we do that help keep our homes ready? 🌧️
